content.text:
**Finding: missing (critical) — no IP/data ownership provision.**

The Agreement has HDI design, develop, host and operate the Site using our Content and Marks, and gives HDI access to our user information and data, but contains no ownership clause at all. Section 5.2 gives us only "exclusive artistic and editorial control," Section 10.2 disclaims co-ownership only as to the relationship, and Section 8 protects confidentiality without vesting title. That leaves ownership of the Site build, our Content and the Site-generated customer/order data unallocated — an unacceptable gap on a critical rule.

Redline (validated, `ok:true`): new **Section 5.5 (Ownership)** inserted after 5.4, which (i) confirms we own our Content, Marks and furnished materials, the Site (including design/look and feel and all work product developed for it) and all Site customer, order and e-mail list data, with HDI assigning any interest; (ii) preserves HDI's pre-existing software, tools and hosting platform subject to a perpetual, irrevocable, worldwide, royalty-free licence back to us; and (iii) bars any assignment to HDI or joint ownership of our IP or data. The comment offers the fallback (HDI retains the underlying build against a perpetual, worldwide, royalty-free licence to use, modify and sublicense) in case HDI resists assignment given it bears the development costs.
